scopeNote: Every CAP case record in U.S. Reports volumes 300–399, preserving source jurisdiction, court labels, and decision dates, including four source dates earlier than the books' 1937–1970 period. This bounded historical reporter collection contains the earlier 347–349 pilot in full; installing both duplicates those records. It is not the complete U.S. Reports or federal collection.

build.cacheConditions: Existing source, model, and embedding caches retained. Utah and U.S. Reports builds overlapped with a 12 GiB JavaScript heap cap per process; this is not an uncached or isolated throughput benchmark.
